integrity: The proof is self-contained for the stated shift. Finite verification is supplementary and does not establish the infinite theorem. Publication priority is not certified.
scientific_limitations: The construction applies to one explicitly defined class of superlacunary positive unilateral weighted shifts.
The step-family separation uses a nonempty compact amplitude set strictly inside the positive real axis.
The claim classifies subsequential operator limits, not norm convergence or all possible weighted-shift cluster sets.
Unindexed or older operator-asymptotics literature might contain an equivalent formulation; no independent audit has been performed.
title: Compact-set universality for cluster limits of sparse weighted-shift modulus roots
